name: Pi 5 EYESPI Beret ILI9341 1.8" alt 160x128 Demo
description: Tests the ILI9341 driver on Raspberry Pi 5 with Adafruit EYESPI Pi Beret. Routes ILI9341 against PID 358's 1.8" 128x160 wiring (the panel itself is ST7735R silicon) so the SPI + displayio path can be exercised without a second TFT on the bench. Responds to checkin, configures the display, then writes test messages.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and Pi 5 style board capabilities

steps.name: add-display
steps.description: Configure ILI9341 driver against PID 358's 1.8-inch wiring on the EYESPI Pi Beret

steps.name: write-hello
steps.description: Write a multi-line test message after add succeeds

write.name: tft-ili9341
write.message:
Pi 5 + EYESPI Beret
ILI9341 (on 128x160)
ProtoMQ path OK

steps.name: write-update
steps.description: Write a second message to verify repeat writes

write.name: tft-ili9341
write.message:
CS=D8 DC=D25 RST=D27
SPI0 MOSI/SCK/MISO
ILI9341 demo complete
